verdict.rationale: E2B documents pause/resume that restores the exact filesystem and memory state, with paused sandboxes kept indefinitely. It also has CLI `e2b sandbox snapshot` commands that save snapshots as named templates, which implies new sandboxes can be created from them. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or example of forking multiple new sandboxes from one snapshot, SDK-level snapshot API documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
